spans.s: अचिकित्स्य impossible to amend, not to be discussed. cf. एवं च 'पूजितो य: सुरैरपि'
आचितादि a class of words headed by the word अाचित which do not have their final vowel accented acute by
when they are preceded by the prepositions प्र, परा etc. although they are used as proper nouns. e.g. आचितम्,निरुक्तम्, प्रश्लिष्टम्; cf. Kāśikā on
